kelly_mkt: FYI, 8 webinar registrants routed to wrong SDR pool after last night's rollout. Seeing timezone mismatches.

omar_ops: Confirmed. Connector restarted at 02:47 UTC, enrichment spike + geo nulls at 02:48.

enrich-bot: Alert: enrichment timeout rate 6% between 02:46-02:50.

jess_sales: I have two EU registrants in the US queue who already received US-time emails.

cory_engineer: Short-term: reassign flagged leads and pause their sequences. Long-term: change fallback to pending-enrich instead of default RR pool when geo missing.

omar_ops: Dry-run command: ./tools/lead_reassign --from 2026-03-30T02:40:00Z --to 2026-03-30T02:55:00Z --check-only

kelly_mkt: Please notify me + Jess before ownership changes on leads that started sequences.

cory_engineer: Will add pre-assign validation and metric assigner.geo_missing.count. Also gate SF push until owner_verified=true.

omar_ops: Dry-run shows 8 candidates (IDs: 31001..31008). Applying now and pausing sequences.

enrich-bot: Job complete: 8 leads moved to pending-enrich at 2026-03-30T03:05:10Z.

jess_sales: Sequences paused. I'll resume after owner_verified.

kelly_mkt: Action items: 1) Omar apply and notify; 2) Cory hotfix geo-guard (10% canary); 3) Marketing draft registrant note if >5 affected. Monitor 24h.

omar_ops: Done. Monitoring metrics and will escalate if geo_null_rate >2% for 10m.

kelly_mkt: Thanks team — we'll include a short retro item on deployment gating and HubSpot workflow guards. :thumbsup:
